profile.headline: Software Engineer at Skool — We're hiring!
profile.summary: A software engineer that's able to take high-level ideas and translate them into beautiful apps, handling everything from the frontend, backend, DevOps, design, and project management.

positions.title: Senior Full-stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Rebuilt several features from Ruby on Rails to React while implementing new design patterns and styles to make features more mobile responsive and user-friendly than the previous implementation at a remarkably fast pace.

• Integrated testing suites via Jest & Enzyme, significantly reducing the number of issues that make it to QA and providing 100% coverage for all React components.

positions.title: UI Engineer
positions.description:
• Made major contributions to a proprietary component library that’s used by UI Engineers across several projects, building new components, improving existing ones, and adding tests.

• Resolved tickets as fast as possible, squashing any bugs that come up and implementing new features while making sure all acceptance criteria are met and designs are exactly followed.

• Optimized the company’s ad viewability code by developing two new methods of tracking impressions that are compatible across a tremendously wider range of environments and much more accurate.

• Architected, designed, and built user interfaces for the company’s backend services, taking tasks that used to have to go from team to team and placing the tools to accomplish these tasks directly in the hands of the people that need them, greatly increasing efficiency.

• Developed UIs at a remarkably fast pace while maintaining exceptional code quality, doing everything from designing and building the front end, engineering the API endpoints, writing tests, and more, competing UIs that normally take weeks in days and sometimes hours.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Resolved technical issues under high pressure circumstances by explaining technology to customers in a very easy to understand manner and using extensive troubleshooting skills, significantly increasing customer retention.

• Oversaw the hiring and training of technicians, making sure they all stayed up to date with new technologies and ahead of their deadlines, reducing the amount of issues escalated to higher tiers by roughly 75%.

• Established the network for the California branch and performed other essential technical tasks involved in the expansion such as tech demos, allowing the company to successfully expand its customer base to the west coast.
